underlines.text: His plan did not vary on seeing them

reference.text: meant to choose one of the daughters, if he found them as handsome and amiable as they were represented by common report.

underlines.text: Mr. Collins had only to change from Jane to Elizabeth

reference.text: Miss Bennet’s lovely face confirmed his views, and established all his strictest notions of what was due to seniority; and for the first evening she was his settled choice.

underlines.text: Mrs. Bennet treasured up the hint

reference.text: “As to her younger daughters, she could not take upon her to say—she could not positively answer—but she did not know of any prepossession;—her eldest daughter she must just mention—she felt it incumbent on her to hint, was likely to be very soon engaged.”
